prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE portrait scene of the SAME place on a later visit. Preserve reference architecture, exact landmarks and spatial orientation. Earnest rustic hand-coloured woodcut on warm ochre paper: slate blue water, muted olive vegetation, clay red accents, warm black irregular cuts. Broad simpler lines, occasional knife slips, dry missed ink and imperfect colour registration. Beautiful old printed landscape, not cute, not a game illustration. Portrait 390:844 composition. No writing, borders, UI, loose inventory objects or people.
SCENE: Same landing the next morning. Dock upper left, sailboat and mailboat, rustic lamps now hang only along upper dock edge. Water right to left, willow left, open pale shore foreground. No clock or timetable pre-painted.
Generous natural play space: the middle 70% of the width from 38% to 90% of the image height is a continuous empty pale ochre clearing or worn floor, with faint sparse print grain only. Keep scenery in the top third and outer margins. No clutter, strong shadows or dense hatching through this open working space. Do not draw a rectangular blank panel.
Any river flows RIGHT to LEFT. Day/night changes affect the sky and edges while the play clearing remains pale, warm and readable.
